errors.text_span: в рамките на периода от януари 2024 до април 2024 г.
errors.evidence: The description states the period is from January 2024 to April 2024, but the x-axis clearly shows dates only within March 2024 (from 3/1/2024 to 3/15/2024).
The x-axis range ends at 3/15/2024, not 15/4/2024.
The dates on the x-axis are arranged in chronological order, not alphabetical order.
The x-axis represents a sequence of days within a single month (March), not a sequence of months.
This date is not present on the chart and is not a valid date. The highest bar corresponds to the date 3/7/2024.
The highest bar, corresponding to 3/7/2024, has a value well above 10.00, approximately 10.5 l/m², not 8.00 l/m².

The bar for 3/1/2024 is not one of the lowest; its value is approximately 3.5. The lowest visible bars are at 3/3/2024 and 3/14/2024 (both near 0). The description incorrectly identifies 3/1/2024 as having one of the lowest values.

The description states the lowest bars have a height of about 2.00 l/m². However, the bars it incorrectly references (3/1/2024 and 3/3/2024) have heights of approximately 3.5 and 0.3 l/m² respectively. Neither is close to 2.00.
